curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How did an ambitious actress navigate Argentina's corridors of power to become one of the country's most fiercely debated political forces?
curatedMovie.description: Directed by Alan Parker, this musical drama follows Argentinian actress Evita Duarte as she ascends to national prominence and marries President Juan Perón, becoming both deeply revered and fiercely resented.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A steady, emotionally heavy historical musical demanding engaged focus, ideal for reflective solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Alan Parker adapts the hit musical into a grand historical drama, exploring the theatricality of political power and the emotional weight carried by a polarizing national figure.
